name: For Love Eternal
summary: In Auberdine, Cerellean Whiteclaw asks you to free Anaya Dawnrunner's spirit from torment in Ameth'Aran. His grief has endured since the city's fall.

sections.title: A Slumber Full of Grief
sections.body: Ten thousand years ago, the War of the Ancients tore ancient Kalimdor apart around the Well of Eternity. The catastrophe destroyed Ameth'Aran and took Anaya Dawnrunner from Cerellean Whiteclaw. Stricken with grief, Cerellean followed Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage into the druids' long hibernation. He hoped that walking the Emerald Dream through the ages would quiet his aching heart, but sorrow remained with him.

sections.title: The Ghost of Ameth'Aran
sections.body: After awakening, Cerellean wandered Darkshore in a stupor until he reached Ameth'Aran's melancholy ruins. Among the ancient stones, he saw Anaya's tortured ghost. He cannot raise a weapon against the woman he loved, so he asks passing travelers to destroy her tormented form, retrieve her pendant, and grant her troubled soul peace.

sections.title: Parting Across the Veil
sections.body: When Anaya's pendant reaches Auberdine, her spectral remnant appears before Cerellean one last time. Freed from the anguish that bound her to the ruins, Anaya gives him a brief farewell, then fades away. By the seaside, the grieving druid weeps with bittersweet solace.

faq.answer: Cerellean Whiteclaw is a night elf druid resting in Auberdine. After losing Anaya in the Sundering ten thousand years ago, he entered the druids' long hibernation with Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage, carrying his sorrow through the ages.
Anaya Dawnrunner was a night elf who lived in Ameth'Aran before the Great Sundering. She died when the city fell after the War of the Ancients, and her ghost remains trapped in its ruins.
Anaya's spirit wanders the ancient, ghost-infested ruins of Ameth'Aran in southern Darkshore, east of the main road.

faq.q: Why couldn't Cerellean free Anaya himself?
faq.answer: Cerellean cannot bear to raise his hand or cast a spell against Anaya's apparition, despite the ten thousand years that have passed and the suffering she endures.
Ameth'Aran was an ancient night elven settlement destroyed in the Sundering that followed the War of the Ancients. Its Darkshore ruins still hold lingering ghosts and arcane echoes.

faq.q: What happens when you return Anaya's pendant?
faq.answer: You bring Anaya's pendant to Cerellean in Auberdine after freeing her troubled spirit. What follows is revealed when you return.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see in Cerellean the personal cost borne by druids who slept for thousands of years beside Shan'do Stormrage, only to wake to a world still marked by ancient losses.
As a night elf of Darkshore, you see in Cerellean's story the lasting scars of the Great Sundering and the fall of your ancient cities.
As an Alliance hero, you see how your night elven allies carry grief across millennia as they adjust to the waking world.
